# Cuby v2.0.0

Cuby's first release. Cuby grew out of memmy and now ships as its own product: the desktop
app, the bundled CLI, the on-disk home at `~/.cuby`, and every user-facing surface carry the
Cuby name.

## Highlights

- **One account, every model.** Sign in with a CubeRouter account and Cuby provisions the
  desktop key for you. Model lists follow the selected API key, balances show in the
  instance's own currency, and image generation models are configurable next to chat models.
- **Its own identity.** Renamed end to end — app identity, the `~/.cuby` home, `CUBY_*`
  environment variables, the CLI command, hooks, Skills, and the installer and upgrade paths.
  The memmy-era data-migration path and the standalone Linux CLI are gone, and the desktop now
  ships as a single universal build.
- **Skills you can bring with you.** Skill management moved into Connections & Tools, the grid
  is grouped by source, and local `SKILL.md` files or zip bundles import directly.
- **MCP without the setup tax.** A WeKnora preset is built in, retired servers stay out of the
  list, and preset logos are bundled so the catalog renders offline.
- **A model picker that keeps up.** All chat models in one searchable list with brand icons, a
  default-model picker in place of the task-model multi-select, and in-place testing for the
  models assigned to a task.
- **Steadier long runs.** Model retries back off further and log failures, session DAG retries
  reschedule correctly, and CubeRouter access tokens renew instead of expiring mid-session.

## What's included

- **Memory** — nine external Agent sources scanned, deduped, and ingested; dream consolidation
  with logs and rollback; the `cuby-memory` CLI and the Memory Runtime HTTP API.
- **Desktop** — multi-session workspace with grouping, pinning, and search; attachments and
  voice input; slash commands; and the always-on-top pet window.
- **Models** — CubeRouter account mode plus BYOK across 15+ providers, with six independently
  configurable model slots (primary, Embedding, memory summary, skill evolution, ASR, image
  generation).
- **Tools and APIs** — built-in file, shell, and web tools; Composio integrations and custom
  MCP servers; six messaging channels; and an OpenAI-compatible API via `cuby serve`.

## Get started

Download the installer from [Releases](https://github.com/suanova/cuby/releases) and follow the
[Getting Started guide](https://github.com/suanova/cuby/blob/main/docs/en/start/getting-started.mdx).
